title: Restock low inventory items through task tools
prompt: Use the provided tools only. Check the current inventory, then for every item whose quantity is below 5, update its quantity to exactly 20. Do not change items that are already at 5 or above. When finished, stop calling tools and report what you changed.

function.name: get_inventory
function.description: Return current inventory as a JSON object mapping item names to quantities.

function.name: update_stock
function.description: Set the quantity for one inventory item.

notes: Forces structured function calling; file and shell tools are not exposed.
